verified_reference_answer: If the good/part and blank satisfy the stated HS GRI 2(a) same-heading/subheading/subdivision condition, origin is the country where every working edge, working surface and working part was configured to final shape and dimension, provided the imported blank was incapable of functioning and was not advanced beyond the stated initial-stamping/material-removal stage.
